methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Time Machine Contrast (Now vs. Then)
content: Problem: Students often use "am/is/are" when talking about the past because they haven't established a clear mental timeline.

Solution: We introduce the "Time Machine". Everything in Block B happens in the past. We explicitly contrast the present state (Now) with the past state (Then) using visual cues like baby photos vs. current photos. The focus is purely on state (adjectives and nouns) using "was/were", completely avoiding action verbs so students master the copula verb in the past tense first.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: S1 pull-out: Show a baby photo. Ask: "Were you big?" Student answers: "No, I was small."
S2 pull-out: Contrast Now and Then. Teacher: "Now I am tall." Student responds with the past: "Then, I was little."
Communicative task: Information Gap (Section 8). "Time Detectives" look at clues (adjectives) to figure out who the baby in the mystery photo is.

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W19: baby, small, cute, little, noisy
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (baby, small, cute, little, noisy) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: was / were (Past state - NO action verbs)
instructions: Grammar focus this week: was / were (Past state - NO action verbs).
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "The Time Detective Agency — The Baby Photo Mystery"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "The Time Detective Agency — The Baby Photo Mystery".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.
Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (baby, small, cute, little, noisy usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.
